messages:
Maya Torres: Heads-up 1 1 EmergentAI case study is nearly ready. I uploaded transcript + audio to the marketing drive. Need legal sign-off, customer quote approval, and final assets by next week.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks Maya. I'll take quote sign-off and coordinate with the customer. Priya, can you confirm the hero image will be a customer asset or do we need a staged shot?
Priya Nair: Customer prefers we use their product screenshot (provided). I'll check resolution and create social crops.
Maya Torres: Draft hero quote: "Redwood's serving cut our inference latency and let us deliver a smarter search experience in half the time."
Liam O'Connor: Slight wording tweak requested by customer: replace "cut" with "reduced" and remove "in half" to avoid absolute claim. Proposed: "Redwood reduced our inference latency, enabling us to ship a smarter search feature much faster." Sending to customer now.
Priya Nair: Editor ETA: I can produce hero image + three social cards + 2x short clips (15s, 30s) by Thu EOD if assets are final. Also will add captions for accessibility.
LegalBot: Legal review initiated for claim language and benchmark disclosure. Please attach methodology note.
Charlie Gomez: Marketing ops note: add UTM params + set form routing to "case-study-inbound" and assign leads to AE queue with tag "emergentai-2026". Also suggest a small gated asset (one-pager) to increase qualified leads.
Liam O'Connor: Customer approved the revised quote and sent signed release (uploaded to drive). Also confirmed they'd join a short webinar segment on 2026-05-18 (15 mins).
Maya Torres: Great. Let's set an embargo: customer asked for publish on 2026-05-20 10:00 PT. Please don't publish before that.
LegalBot: Legal note: benchmark numbers must be phrased as "approximately Xx improvement" and cite internal test ID T-2026-31. Also redact any PII observed in transcript.
Priya Nair: Noted. I'll redact timestamps/names per legal. Asset checklist updated in the doc: hero quote, long quote (customer-approved), hero image (customer screenshot), 3 social cards, 2 clips, one-pager PDF, landing page draft, embed player, HubSpot form with routing.
Charlie Gomez: I'll create the HubSpot form and pre-fill lead routing. Also scheduling the webinar invite; will include speaker bios and a short prep doc for customer.
Maya Torres: Can someone own the landing page copy? Need to finalize the benchmark callout and methodology blurb. Liam?
Liam O'Connor: I'll draft the landing copy by Tue EOD and include the approved phrasing for benchmarks.
Priya Nair: I'll upload final assets once legal confirms redactions. ETA for final exports: Fri 2026-05-15 EOD.
LegalBot: Release and redaction complete. Signed release file: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/emergentai/RELEASE_1777654689.pdf. Legal approves publication after embargo and customer preview.
Maya Torres: Perfect. Final steps: Liam to publish landing copy for customer preview by Mon 05/18, Priya to upload final assets, Charlie to configure lead routing and webinar invite. We'll reconvene in this thread for any last-minute checks. :sparkles:
